items.title: Amazon blocks Meta's Muse AI agent from shopping on its site
items.excerpt: Meta's agent became the No. 1 free app in Apple's US store within a week, then met a popup citing Amazon's usage terms. Contract claims are Amazon's open route.

items.title: Meta's Muse accounts for 72% of AI agent requests, HUMAN finds
items.excerpt: Of Muse's requests, 84% target product and search pages, and it is 25% more likely than other agents to reach checkout. Can analytics tell the traffic apart?

items.title: Denmark's deepfake bill makes publishers prove consent from January 2027
items.excerpt: Realistic fakes of any face, voice or movement would need permission, with protection running 50 years after death. What does bill L 49 mean for AI-made ads?

items.title: How Does Agentic Buying Work In CTV?
items.excerpt: Given how much agentic AI pervades nearly every conversation these days, it’s easy to overlook how nascent the technology still is, particularly when it comes to buying ads on connected TV.

items.title: Who Eats The Gap When Agentic Spend Outpaces Proof Of Impact?
items.excerpt: An AI agent can stay inside its budget and still spend too much. And the evidence of campaign performance can still arrive after the money is committed.

items.title: Nestlé Mexico Had More Scale Than It Knew What To Do With – Until It Unified Its Data
items.excerpt: Prior to adopting Treasure AI, Nestlé Mexico had looked at data and targeting on a brand-by-brand basis. Now, its entire portfolio is unified in one system.

items.title: As agencies push agentic media future, execs work to ward off client rogue fears
items.excerpt: With no shortage of news on media agencies moving forward with agentic initiatives, how they’re dealing with client concerns.

items.title: OpenAI would like to remind marketers that its ads are for the good of humanity
items.excerpt: OpenAI says it knowing who users are matters less. Its advertising business and ambitions on ChatGPT is betting on it.

items.title: Why ChatGPT ads won't likely impact holiday sales in a major way this year
items.excerpt: Brands are starting to test OpenAI's ChatGPT ads. But high costs and weak sales are deterring them ahead of the holiday season.

items.title: Modern Retail+ Research: How agencies adapt to a media landscape shaped by AI and creators
items.excerpt: Modern Retail+ Research examines how AI search and creator marketing are adding another layer of change to the agency landscape.

items.title: Virtual try on launches on ChatGPT
items.excerpt: Users can take or upload a selfie to generate images and see how clothing and accessories look on them prior to purchase.

items.title: OpenAI Wants ChatGPT Ads to Become a Permanent Line Item in Agency Media Plans
items.excerpt: An Agency Partner listing shows OpenAI building the holding-company sales layer that Meta and Google use to lock in recurring spend.

items.title: Google Ads Text Customization Asset Previews
items.excerpt: Google Ads now lets you preview the assets generated by Google AI for your Google Ads AI Max campaigns. Google added these details to the About text customization in Search campaigns help page under a new section named "Text customization asset previews."

items.title: AI In Regulated Paid Media: The Default Settings That Put Compliance At Risk
items.excerpt: Protect approved ads in regulated industries by auditing Google and Meta AI settings that can alter creative or expand audiences in paid media campaigns.

items.title: How Liquid Death is building an AI-native marketing organization
items.excerpt: Benoit Vatere, chief media and digital commerce officer at the brand, explained at Advertising Week how it is using the tech to move faster than competitors.

items.title: Your Customer’s Personal Agent Is Knocking. Is Your Business Ready to Answer?
items.excerpt: With the advent of personal AI agents, every business is grappling with the same question: Let them in or block them at the front door?
